surprises.title: C-wire is missing
surprises.description: The app wants a C-wire. Four wires, none labeled C.

options.text: Replace the whole HVAC system
Use the spare wire as the C
Install an adapter kit at the furnace

surprises.title: Wires lose their labels
surprises.description: You forgot to take a photo. Now four anonymous wires dangle from the wall.

options.text: Call an HVAC tech
Connect them by color and hope
Trace them at the furnace control board

surprises.title: Transformer blows
surprises.description: You crossed two wires. The furnace goes silent, and there's a faint burning smell.

options.text: Replace the furnace
Replace the furnace fuse or transformer
Keep flipping the breaker

surprises.title: Heat pump runs backwards
surprises.description: Turns out you have a heat pump. You ask for heat, and it blows cold air.

options.text: Swap wires until something works
Replace the heat pump
Change the O/B setting in the app

surprises.title: Wall rectangle shows
surprises.description: The new thermostat is tiny. The old one left a big rectangle of unpainted wall.

options.text: Patch and paint the wall
Use a trim plate
Repaint the whole hallway

surprises.title: Furnace is ancient
surprises.description: The furnace label says 1987. The thermostat app says "incompatible."

options.text: Force it to work with jumper wires
Replace the furnace today
Pick one that works with old systems

surprises.title: System short-cycles
surprises.description: The heat clicks on and off every two minutes. The house has hiccups.

options.text: Tweak the cycles, check the filter
Unplug it. Space heaters forever
Replace the HVAC system

surprises.title: Wi-Fi can't reach
surprises.description: The thermostat can't find Wi-Fi. Your router is in the farthest corner of the house.

options.text: Move the router to the hallway floor
Add a mesh Wi-Fi node
Run Ethernet through the whole house

surprises.title: Filter is filthy
surprises.description: At the furnace, you find an air filter that's gray and fuzzy like an old sweater.

options.text: Install a whole-house air purifier
Replace the filter
Vacuum it and put it back

surprises.title: Old thermostat has mercury
surprises.description: The old thermostat has a little glass bulb of mercury inside.

options.text: Take it to a hazardous waste drop-off
Hire a hazmat crew
Toss it in the trash

surprises.title: Condensate line clogs
surprises.description: You test the AC, and water starts pooling under the furnace.

options.text: Put a towel under it
Replace the AC unit
Clear the condensate line

surprises.title: Sun fools the sensor
surprises.description: The thermostat sits next to a sunny window and thinks it's summer all afternoon.

options.text: Install zone control in every room
Move the thermostat to another wall
Add a remote room sensor

surprises.title: Smart home bug bites
surprises.description: The thermostat works great. Now you want smart locks, lights, and blinds.

options.text: Buy them all and leave them in boxes
Pick one device for next month
Automate the entire house this weekend

surprises.title: Duct cleaning ad appears
surprises.description: The thermostat app suggests a duct cleaning service. With a coupon!

options.text: Check the filter and registers first
Book a full duct replacement
Vacuum the ducts with the shop vac

surprises.title: Partner feels cold
surprises.description: Your partner: "Now that it's smart, can the bedroom be warmer than the living room?"

options.text: Install a zoned system with new dampers
Put a space heater by the thermostat
Set up a room sensor schedule

video.title: Smart thermostat install, C-wire and all

ask.question: How do I install a smart thermostat?
ask.answer: Easy! 1. Pull off the old one. 2. Connect the wires. 3. Download the app!
ask.skipped: It skipped the C-wire and labeling the wires.
